-- Deterministic step of a linear congruential generator, kept in [0, 2^31).
lcg(state: int) -> int =
  post out >= 0
  post out < 2147483648
  ex lcg(1) >= 0
  ((state % 2147483648) * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483648

-- Returns a permutation of xs whose order depends only on seed.
shuffled(xs: List[int], seed: int) -> List[int] =
  pre seed >= 0
  post out.len() == xs.len()
  ex shuffled([1], 7) == [1]
  ex shuffled([1, 2, 3], 9) == shuffled([1, 2, 3], 9)
  var ys = copy xs
  var state = seed
  var i = ys.len() - 1
  while i > 0
    state = lcg(state)
    let j = state % (i + 1)
    let tmp = ys[i]
    ys[i] = ys[j]
    ys[j] = tmp
    i -= 1
  ys
